desks.notes: Amendment dated Oct 27, 2026 to the Apr 3, 2026 voting agreement among MGM, People Inc and Barry Diller. Covered entities won't buy above 29.9% (issuer buybacks pushing them over are not a breach). On non-change-of-control votes, shares above 25.73% of voting power are voted pro rata with the unaffiliated majority. On change-of-control votes, all shares vote per the MGM board recommendation if People's designees sit on the transaction committee, the counterparty is unaffiliated, and People gets the same per-share consideration. No transactions in the past 60 days.
